analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($446.53) vs SMA5/20/50 ($434.86/$424.77/$417.09): trading above short/mid-term trends, indicating bullish position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($419.95/$378.98): maintaining mid/long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (84.7%) + current price level approaching historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.5→62.5) + exiting oversold and entering neutral zone, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.3263→2.3120) + improvement confirmed, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $445.99) + approaching upper band, with band width expanding to 9.99%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($419.19) + support confirmed based on SMA100.
· Swing resistance ($450.16) + potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + confirming uptrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.34x) + low volume period, indicating potential weakening of upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + expectation of further upside on breaking 52-week high, with caution for short-term overheating.
